scenario_text:
This one has no user interface at all. It's a back-office component that picks
up meter readings our field devices submit through a separate gateway we don't
control, validates them, and writes them into the readings store — about 45 GB
of history. Devices submit in bursts when they come back online, so the work
has to sit somewhere until a worker gets to it rather than being dropped.
Roughly 20 workers running at once. Nothing is ever read back by a person
through this component. Host is 6 GB RAM, 4 vCPU. Nightly backups.

RabbitMQ could be considered for message queuing, but Redis is sufficient here given simplicity and the existing workload pattern. Therefore, I will select 'postgres' and 'redis'. I will generate a configuration with these services, tailored for the workload and hardware constraints.
